items.title: Jack DeJohnette interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 7, 2025
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...you did a session with her. [INTERVIEWEE] Right.

ctx.x: No I just tune by my intuition, by ear — I hear a pitch I like and then I go to the other tom. And you know make a nice melodic sequence.
I was happy to see — I have the whole collection of Marian McPartland’s “Piano Jazz” and you did a session with her.
